text: One of the problems I have with agentic coding is that I end up with lots of workspaces and branches sticking around long after they're useful. Right now, on my Prelude project landing page, I have a design branch that claims to have an open PR, even though that PR was merged, and I already have an attempted fix that didn't solve the problem. Let's explore some kind of a relatively mechanical (as opposed to agentic) utility that allows me to see which branches/workspaces/sesssions can be cleaned up and then the ability to actually clean them up.

I think I've found why the PR still shows as open, and I have a plan for the cleanup tool. I haven't built anything yet.

## Why the merged PR still says "open"

- **The open-PR label is never cleared.** "Pull request open" comes from a `published` field in `~/.prelude/builds.json`. It's set when the branch is pushed (`server/branches.js:625`), and nothing ever clears it or checks whether the PR was merged.
- **Cleanup only removes a branch whose last commit is in main.** The automatic cleanup (`tidy()` at `server/branches.js:635`) removes a branch only when its last commit is already in main (`:476`). Your branch kept going after #33 merged: this session is working on it now. So its last commit isn't in main, it's never removed, and it still claims the PR is open. A squash-merged PR would hit the same problem, because main gets a new commit rather than the branch's own.

## Proposal: a "Clean up…" window on the project page

It would open from the In progress card and list everything that has piled up. Each item gets a plain reason, worked out by rules rather than by an agent:

| What | How it's detected | Default |
|---|---|---|
| A branch whose work is in main | last commit is in main or origin's main | checked |
| A branch whose PR merged, with work since | the commit that was pushed is in main | unchecked, says "N commits since the merge" |
| A squash-merged branch | the branch's changes are already in main | checked |
| A branch with nothing done | still where it started, older than about a week | checked |
| An entry whose worktree folder is gone | listed in `builds.json` but no folder on disk | checked |
| A stray worktree or `prelude/*` branch | in git or on disk but not in `builds.json` (e.g. an abandoned fix) | unchecked |
| A pushed branch on origin | the remote copy of anything removed | separate checkbox, off by default |
| Folders a previous cleanup couldn't delete | still on disk, usually held by a running program | checked |

- **Never offered for removal:** anything with uncommitted changes, or with a turn running right now.
- **The Remove button** works through the checked items, stopping any running design host first as cleanup does now. Each removal is recorded under "Merged lately", and the page refreshes.
- **Separately, a small fix:** the PR pill would show only while the pushed commit isn't in main, so your branch would stop claiming its PR is open.

A few questions before I build it:

1. **By "sessions", do you mean the agent conversations stored in each design's `sessions/` folder?** Those are merged into main as history. Or do you mean running agents and design hosts?
2. **Should this live on each project's page, or on Home across all projects?** I'd start with the project page.
3. **Should it ever delete branches on origin?** I'd make that opt-in each time.

I've added the cause and this open question to `NOTES.md`.
